title: AISU 50ml Shortfill – Pink Guava
description:
Aisu’s Pink Guava shortfill e-liquid is a delicate blend blended with ice. On the inhale, you’ll get a pink guava flavor that’s mostly sweet but also a little sour. On exhale, the inclusion of menthol gives a layered taste with a smooth texture.
AISU Pink Guava has 70%VG / 30%PG for maximum flavour enhancement and dense clouds and comes in a 60ml bottle with space for a nicotine shot .
70% / 30% | VG / PG
